app.name: Vukem Rifa
app.tagline: Create your online raffle, get paid via PIX and draw transparently.

home.title: Online raffles with PIX
home.lead: Create a raffle, generate a payment link per number and let the automatic, auditable draw do the rest.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: We will email you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, we sent a password reset link.

reset.done: Your password was reset. You can log in now.
reset.invalid: This password reset link is invalid or has expired.

verify.lead: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to verify your address.
verify.resent: A new verification link was sent.
verify.wrong_account: This verification link belongs to another account.

social.no_email: Your {provider} account did not share an email address.
social.exists: An account with this email already exists. Log in with your password first.

too_small.string: The {field} field must be at least {min} characters.
too_small.number: The {field} field must be at least {min}.

too_small.array: The {field} field must have at least {min} items.

too_big.string: The {field} field must not be greater than {max} characters.
too_big.number: The {field} field must not be greater than {max}.
too_big.array: The {field} field must not have more than {max} items.

string.email: The {field} field must be a valid email address.
string.url: The {field} field must be a valid URL.
string.uuid: The {field} field must be a valid UUID.

string.alpha: The {field} field must only contain letters.
string.alphanum: The {field} field must only contain letters and numbers.
string.numeric: The {field} field must be a number.
string.utf8: The {field} field must be valid text.
